summary.text: Joseph Charafi is the Republican candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Las Vegas communications consultant, filmmaker and nonprofit leader, he is the founder and president of the Stop the Traffic Foundation.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Charafi graduated from Valley High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the Art Institute of Colorado in 2010.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Las Vegas small business owner, filmmaker, nonprofit leader and father who grew up in Las Vegas.
He said he founded the Stop the Traffic Foundation, a nonprofit focused on combating human trafficking and protecting vulnerable children.
Charafi advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.

In the survey he listed his campaign messages as greater transparency in state spending, protecting children through stronger trafficking prevention and child welfare accountability, and encouraging entrepreneurship and private-sector job creation while keeping taxes and regulatory burdens under control.
He listed endorsements from Veterans In Politics International, the Nevada Veterans Association, the NRA Political Action Fund and Save Nevada PAC.
